item.tib: g.yung drung srid pa'i mthu lung rgyal mo rgyud kyis yang snying ma mo gzer bu'i khol bcud man ngag 'phrul lde yi khog pa 'grel pa nyi ma'i snying po lag khrid ston pa ye gshen gtsug phud kyis mdzad pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra ye gshen gtsug phud kyis/ ma mo 'dus pa'i rgyud zab la/ man ngag rgyud gsum dril nas su/ gcig tu dril ba'i zab tig 'dis ('di)/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa la/ bka' yi rgya dang bcas nas stad (gtad)/ stag la me 'bar thugs mdzod bstim/ stong rgyung mthu chen gter du sbas/ gshen chen klu dgas gter nas bston (bton)/ lha rje rin chen gdung rgyud 'dzin/ dam pa rgyal tshab sgrub pa bsnyen/ dag bon sgom stag bka' lung babs/ dag bon nyi rgyal ma mo 'grub (grub)/ brag rdzog bsgrub (sgrub) gshen sgrub rtags phyin/ grong gtod mtshams pas bsgrub (sgrub) rgyud 'dzin/ kong smad rin po che'i bka'/ sum bon mkhas grub rad nas 'dzin/ yi ge pa ni mar rgan thugs rdor ro/ dge bshes spun gnyis la dgos zer ba/ tsha shubs gnas grong du bkod pa'o//
